select ee.ENTRUST_DATE entrustDate , ee.FINPROD_ID finprodId , fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId , fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr , fp.ISSUE_TYPE issueType , fpi.ISSUE_DATE issueDate , fpi.PAY_DATE payDate , fpi.ISSUE_PRICE issuePrice , fpi.REFER_YIELD referenceRate , fpi.REFER_YIELD rate , eea.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId , ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName , ee.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerName , ee.CCY ccy , ee.REMARK remark , pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName , eed.ENTRUST_NUM*100 bidPrinAmt , ee.INV_AIM businessModel from ETR_ENTRUST ee left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = ee.FINPROD_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eea on eea.ENTRUST_ID = ee.ENTRUST_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi on fpi.FINPROD_ID = ee.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON eea.SEC_ACCT_ID = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on eed.ENTRUST_ID = ee.ENTRUST_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID
ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} /*指令代码查询*/
